decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already updates the FAQ to describe direct prize transfer and winner notifications; no additional or corrected Event is required.
Changing prize collection from manual claim to automatic wallet transfer does not alter winner eligibility, randomness, fairness, or selection execution.
The payout workflow does not change which sales fund prize pools or how long funding continues.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already records that the Transak-created wallet receives prizes; the payout-mode decision requires no further change to the fiat on-ramp state.
Automatic prize transfer does not change the Big Block winner count, prize amount, draw trigger, or eligible population.
Automatic prize transfer does not change the Small Block winner count, prize amount, draw trigger, or eligible population.

The source's winner-notification email is distinct from the mint confirmation email and ebook certificate behavior represented by this Requirement; its existing message-184 Event needs no payout-workflow amendment.
The payout workflow does not change the mint number's role, persistence, or display as a referral code.
The source changes collection of a won prize, not the random allocation of commissions and tickets when a mint has no referral code.
Automatic winner payout does not alter ticket counters, eligibility windows, winning chances, or post-draw reset behavior.
The existing message-184 Event independently establishes the ebook reader behavior; the prize payout decision does not alter that reader state.
Changing from manual prize claim to automatic transfer does not necessarily alter the currently specified ticket counters, badges, or referral-code metadata.
